name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for LLMFirewall-Core
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'discussion']
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include proposed public APIs or method signatures where applicable.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Architectural & Security Impact
- Does this introduce new external dependencies? (Core must remain minimal)
- Does this impact the sub-millisecond latency budget?
- Does this require Policy-as-Code updates?

## Additional context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups about the feature request here.
